items.stem: A concrete cylinder fails its 28-day strength test. Before blaming the mix design, what is the most important thing to check first?

options.text: Whether the samples were made, cured and tested correctly to the standard
options.rationale: Correct: sampling, curing and testing errors are a common cause of apparent failures.
Aggregate colour does not determine strength results.

options.text: Whether it rained anywhere that month
options.rationale: General weather is not the first thing to verify.

options.text: The brand of the mixer truck
options.rationale: Truck brand is not a controlling factor for test validity.

items.explanation: Correct: sampling, curing and testing errors are a common cause of apparent failures.

items.stem: Which TWO properties make timber attractive as a structural material? (Select TWO.)

options.rationale: Correct: timber is strong relative to its weight.
Correct: responsibly sourced timber is renewable.
Timber is susceptible to moisture and decay without protection.
Timber is combustible; it is not non-combustible.

items.explanation: Correct: timber is strong relative to its weight.

items.stem: Why is proper curing critical for in-situ concrete?

options.text: It keeps moisture available so the cement can continue to hydrate and gain strength
options.rationale: Correct: curing maintains hydration and strength development.

options.text: It makes the concrete a darker colour
options.rationale: Appearance is not the purpose of curing.

options.text: It removes the need for any reinforcement
It allows the formwork to stay on forever
options.rationale: Curing is unrelated to leaving formwork permanently.

items.explanation: Correct: curing maintains hydration and strength development.
